{{dablink|For other uses of the word "silver," see [[Silver]].}}
'''The Silver Swan''' is an inn in [[Caemlyn]] which seems to be one of the best in the city and one of the [[Aes Sedai]] preferred places in the capital.

==History==
While Rand was ruling Caemlyn, Aes Sedai with [[Warders]] come and go frequently, never more than nine at any time{{ref/book|7|6}}. As Red sisters did not stay there, and the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] stayed at [[The Crown of Roses]] inn, it can be assumed those in the Silver Swan were most likely [[unaligned sisters]], presumably owing allegiance to [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]].

Sisters continued to stay there after Rand left the city and when Elayne arrived in the capital some time later, there were ten Aes Sedai {{ref/book|9|6}}; they never approached her and Elayne kept them under surveillance and suspected that their movements were coordinated by someone.

After [[Talaan]] and [[Merilille]] disappeared from the Royal Palace, [[Chanelle]] sent [[Renaile]] to the Silver Swan to demand the Aes Sedai to return them, or pay what the Tower owes the Sea Folk{{ref/book|11|12}}. Obviously the Aes Sedai in the inn did not know anything about the two runaways, but at the same time this was most probably the way how [[Amylia]] met the [[Windfinders]] and then she was recruited as new teacher in Merilille place.
